name: God Did Not Send The Son Into The World To Condemn The World
overview: In John 3, we see that God’s purpose in sending His Son into the world was not to bring condemnation, but to offer salvation. While Nicodemus, a Jewish ruler, sought understanding, the Scriptures clarify that God’s love motivated Him to give His only begotten Son so that anyone who believes in Him will receive eternal life. This passage emphasizes that Christ’s mission is centered on redemption and life, not judgment.
